content: This link is for {{productName}} users only. Sign in, then open the link again.

comment.text: Message with a Sign in button on the page of an external link of a private (end-to-end encrypted) room, shown to a visitor who is not signed in when the link is only for users of the portal. {{productName}} is the product name and stays untranslated. After signing in the visitor has to open the link address again. Two full sentences with periods.
